issues.description: The problem statement declares simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots:int, p: float, batch_size:float = 1000000.0) with batch_size default typed as float (1000000.0), whereas the template and solution both declare simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) with an integer batch_size. This minor signature/type mismatch (float vs int default) is structural and could confuse students about the expected type for batch_size.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the batch_size parameter type consistent across artifacts. Either change the problem statement to use an integer default (batch_size: int = 1000000) or update the template and solution signatures to accept a float default. Prefer using an int for batch sizes and update the problem statement to batch_size: int = 1000000 for clarity.
